summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to include peer support services provided by certified specialists at community mental health centers, rural health clinics, and federally qualified health centers as covered benefits under the Medicare program, effective January 1, 2027.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands Medicare coverage to include peer support services for mental health and substance use conditions. This represents an expansion of public healthcare services under Medicare.

By expanding Medicare to cover peer support services, the bill enhances the social safety net by providing additional support for individuals with mental health and substance use conditions, which can be seen as a form of welfare expansion.

The bill specifically includes peer support services for individuals with substance use disorders under Medicare. This aims to provide recovery services, which can be interpreted as a relaxed approach to drug enforcement by focusing on treatment and support rather than solely punitive measures.
